name: Cargo Manifest Report
query: SELECT name as 'Cargo ID:Link/Cargo Booking:120', trip as 'Trip:Link/Bus Trip:120', sender_name as 'Sender:Data:150', sender_contact as 'Sender Contact:Data:120', receiver_name as 'Receiver:Data:150', receiver_contact as 'Receiver Contact:Data:120', source_station as 'From:Link/Bus Station:120', destination_station as 'To:Link/Bus Station:120', item_description as 'Item:Data:200', weight_kg as 'Weight (KG):Float:100', cargo_charges as 'Charges:Currency:110', booking_date as 'Booking Date:Date:110', status as 'Status:Data:100', sales_invoice as 'Sales Invoice:Link/Sales Invoice:120' FROM `tabCargo Booking` ORDER BY booking_date DESC
